title: Trade flow and observed impact direction
claim: Causal aggressive-flow and observed-impact fields may improve return forecasts beyond aggregated market state.
mechanism: Aggressive flow can be informed or liquidity-demanding; continuation, reversal, and null are all eligible outcomes.
target: Outright or factor-residual basket-member log return.
horizon: Locked campaign horizon grid, limited by archive timestamp quality.
informationSet: Aggregate trades, taker imbalance, observed price impact, and market controls
primaryBaseline: Strongest frozen model without flow-specific fields

evidence.summary: All 104 basket-4 attempts failed and no basket-6 or basket-10 trial was completed, so the ledger establishes operational failure rather than predictive rejection or support.

nextAction: Diagnose the preserved basket-4 failures and archive event-quality limits before any fresh registration; do not rerun the same family or infer a predictive result.
